free_tier_limits.correction: Personal development keys are free with short-term expiration (typically 24h renewal) and low rate limits; production keys free after application approval with higher limits. Exact rate numbers are app-specific and shown in the developer portal.

rate_limits.correction: Personal keys typically have app-specific limits shown in the developer portal (commonly ~20 req/1s and ~100 req/2min historically, but not guaranteed); production apps get higher limits after approval.

example.correction: Summoner-by-name endpoint is deprecated/removed; use Riot ID / PUUID-based endpoints. Example: curl -H "X-Riot-Token: YOUR_API_KEY" "https://na1.api.riotgames.com/lol/summoner/v4/summoners/by-puuid/{puuid}"
